summary: Players use a shared rondel of colored dice to gather resources and place them on a communal cathedral structure, fulfilling personal contracts for points while also caring about majority control on the cathedral itself. It's a tight, midweight euro with a clever mix of individual engine-building and shared-board area control.
praised: Nice tension between personal contracts and shared cathedral
Good production for a smaller box
criticised: Can feel a bit fiddly to learn at first

interaction.detail: The cathedral itself is a shared, physical structure players build onto together, so there's direct competition for tile placement and majorities, layered over each player's own contract cards and resource stock.

scoring.why: Points come from completed contracts plus majority bonuses on the shared cathedral and leftover resources
scoring.how_you_win: You win by completing high-value contracts and securing good positions on the communal cathedral more efficiently than your opponents.

similar: Merv: The Heart of the Silk Road
